title: Gold metrics
description: The four business questions and the freshness of gold, read from the gold views.

panels.title: Freshness: time since the newest change
panels.description: Per entity, the time since the source commit of the newest change gold holds (gold.data_freshness). It grows while the source is idle, even when the pipeline is healthy.

targets.rawSql:
-- Time since the newest change gold holds, per entity; it also grows while the source is idle.
SELECT entity, extract(epoch FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - last_changed_at) AS lag_seconds
FROM gold.data_freshness
ORDER BY entity;

panels.title: Open orders by delivery date and status
panels.description: Open orders (any status but COMPLETED, not deleted) per delivery date and status.

targets.rawSql:
-- Number of open orders by delivery date and status.
SELECT delivery_date, status_code, open_orders
FROM gold.open_orders_by_delivery_date_and_status
ORDER BY delivery_date, status_code;

panels.title: Top 3 delivery dates by open orders
panels.description: The delivery dates with the most open orders; ties for third place are included.

targets.rawSql:
-- Top 3 delivery dates with more open orders, ties for third place included.
SELECT delivery_date, open_orders
FROM gold.top_delivery_dates_by_open_orders
ORDER BY open_orders DESC, delivery_date;

panels.title: Pending items by product
panels.description: Items of open orders per product: the number of items and their total quantity.

targets.rawSql:
-- Number of open pending items by product: items of open orders.
SELECT product_id, pending_items, pending_quantity
FROM gold.pending_items_by_product
ORDER BY product_id;

panels.title: Top 3 customers by pending orders
panels.description: The customers with the most open orders; ties for third place are included.

targets.rawSql:
-- Top 3 customers with more pending (open) orders, ties for third place included.
SELECT customer_id, customer_name, pending_orders
FROM gold.top_customers_by_pending_orders
ORDER BY pending_orders DESC, customer_id;
